# 00000008729

**English.** Definition: The quasi-local algebra is the star algebra of exponentially decaying operators in the MBL phase. Conjecture: The algebra is always generated by l-bit polynomials with the number of central generators linear; the von Neumann closure in the thermal phase is the full matrix algebra, and the two-phase criterion is the closure type. (l-bit algebra central linear generation)

**中文。** 定义：准局域代数指 MBL 相中指数衰减算子的星代数。猜想：该代数恒由 l-比特 多项式生成且中心生成元数为线性；von Neumann 闭包在热相为全矩阵代数而两相判据为闭包类型。（l-比特 代数中心线性生成）
